title: Combine Two Integers
statement: Read two integers and print their sum.
constraints: Two integers a and b, each from -1,000,000,000 through 1,000,000,000.
format: Input: two whitespace-separated integers a b. Output: their sum as one integer.

title: Greatest of Three
statement: Read three integers and print the greatest value. Equal greatest values are allowed.
constraints: Three integers a, b and c, each from -1,000,000,000 through 1,000,000,000.
format: Input: three whitespace-separated integers a b c. Output: the greatest value, once.

title: Sum the Even Numbers
concept: Bounded loops and accumulation; alternative arithmetic formula
statement: Print the sum of all even integers from 1 through n, including n when it is even. If there are no such integers, print 0.
constraints: One integer n from 0 through 100,000. Use a 64-bit integer in Java/C#; the sum can exceed a 32-bit signed integer.
format: Input: one integer n. Output: the sum as one integer.

title: Sum the Digits
statement: Print the sum of the decimal digits of the absolute value of n. The digit sum of 0 is 0.
constraints: One integer n from -1,000,000,000 through 1,000,000,000. Ignore its sign; leading zeroes do not change its numeric value.
format: Input: one integer n. Output: its digit sum as one integer.
